headline: Trade lower persona consistency for reduced serving costs with {arm:f64}, or retain {arm:prod} to preserve character fidelity.
lede: {arm:f64} reduces reply expense from {cost_per_1k.prod|usd} to {cost_per_1k.f64|usd} per thousand while {judged.persona.prod} degrades to {judged.persona.f64} on {aspects.persona.name}. Adopting it depends on whether the team accepts fidelity degradation in conversations beyond turn {strata.depth:3-5.name}.

slots.text: Switching to {arm:f64} trims costs by thirty percent but drops {aspects.persona.name} by {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|pts}), while keeping guardrails intact.
Choose {arm:f64} if saving ten cents per thousand replies justifies losing one point of persona adherence. Retain {arm:prod} if persona degradation must remain below five points.
Lean toward {arm:f64} if overall cost reduction is prioritized and conversations concentrate in early turns.
Human preference trials on extended conversations or setting an explicit minimum threshold for {aspects.persona.name} at depth {strata.depth:6-10.name}.

method.text: Evaluated across {scoreboard.prod.cases} dialogue scenarios run across multi-turn sessions totaling {scoreboard.prod.ran} responses per arm.
{aspects.persona.name} assessed by a calibrated model judge validated on {judged.persona.calibration_ratings} human comparisons with agreement score {judged.persona.agreement}.
Music facts evaluated against catalog truth (pass at {criteria.facts.threshold|pct}); speculation refusal evaluated on bait prompts (pass at {criteria.specul.threshold|pct}).
Calculated using token usage multiplied by standard list pricing per thousand queries, accounting for increasing context length.
{family.level} paired differences against control without multiplicity correction across challengers.
Deterministic programmatic validation checking whether queue, skip, or announce actions execute properly.

flag.title: No Decision Rule Set in Advance
flag.text: No exchange rate between reply cost and persona adherence was set ahead of time. Product leadership must determine whether unit savings justify character loss.

sections.headline: All challenger models regress on character consistency relative to production
sections.takeaway: {arm:cor} drops the least at {contrast.cor.persona.delta|pts} points, while {arm:f16} shows the steepest drop at {contrast.f16.persona.delta|pts} points.

sections.headline: Character fidelity decays sharply at deeper turns for Flash models
sections.takeaway: In the deepest conversations of turns {strata.depth:11+.name}, persona consistency drops most severely for {arm:f64} and {arm:f16} compared to {arm:prod}.

sections.headline: Taking corrections and banter drive the largest drops in persona
sections.takeaway: Across all models, song intros remain stable while handling user corrections causes severe persona decay.
